prior_summary: Chunk-start TCP-frame translation and rotation-vector targets, conditioned on causal relative geometry and explicit clearance/alignment/progress cues, reanchor every execution chunk for off-timing handoff states.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when the peg is still held but a neighboring skill hands off at a valid non-nominal phase, current tcp_pose is trustworthy, two-frame motion is available, and scene displacement is modest.
termination_guidance: Transfer to insertion when causal observations show stable coupling, near hole-axis orientation, y/z centering, and descent to hole height. Use any of the retained [1380,1500) overlap for robust takeover.
limitations: Local coordinates do not guarantee a globally correct route under large fixture displacement. Reanchoring cannot recover lost contact, collision, unreachable configurations, or large accumulated execution error.
